preset: preset · content in a kit tab

features.feature: Dán link · nguồn · kit
features.ours: One box: paste a URL, pick a source, or write text; channel and kit pickers beside it.
features.reason: Slice 0. Sources day one: news RSS, Reddit, article URL, own text, own-account Threads. Other people's Meta posts: paste the text.

features.feature: 4 chế độ: Đọc bài · Viết lời · Lồng tiếng · Video dọc
features.ours: `mode` on the run: read-post · write-narration · voice-over-media · text-to-reel.
features.reason: Slice 1. Lồng tiếng works today because startRenderJob already takes media[].

features.feature: Gợi ý từ kho nguồn · Kết quả gần đây
features.ours: Suggestions = gold posts of this channel with no reel yet; Recent = last runs.
features.reason: Slice 0. Same query feeds the Library's bottom strip.

features.feature: kit · thời lượng · bình luận · duyệt trước
features.ours: Per-run override drawer (overrides_json), merged over the kit at run time; never writes back to the kit.
features.reason: Slice 1. Duyệt trước = auto_continue off; duration = the budget gate's band; comment mode auto/manual = the pool.

features.feature: intro · layout · nhạc · style
features.ours: Toggles in the same drawer.
features.reason: Slice 1/3. Each maps to a flag the render job already accepts (--no-intro, includeLayout, style, music tier).

features.feature: che mặt · SFX · GIF phản ứng · outro CTA
features.ours: Not in make-reel.py.
features.reason: A renderer feature, not a surface one. Belongs to a second plan after the surface exists and has been used.

features.feature: chất lượng HD/30fps
features.ours: One output quality.
features.reason: Nothing to choose; the renderer has one profile.

features.feature: Thương hiệu: tên · logo · hashtag
features.ours: identity + post tabs of the kit.
features.reason: Slice 4.

features.feature: Nội dung: cách kể · chọn bình luận · độ dài
features.ours: post tab (format), channel default for comment mode, budget gate range.
features.reason: Slice 4; the pool itself is on the run page (Slice 1–3).

features.feature: Giọng đọc: giọng · tốc độ · ngắt · đọc thử
features.ours: voice tab: edge-tts voice id, rate, pause ms, test read.
features.reason: Slice 4. The owner's cloned voice (bao) is a later provider.

features.feature: nhiều giọng theo câu
features.ours: make-reel calls TTS once for the whole narration, by design (one network call).
features.reason: Changing that is engine work; measured $0 path stays.

features.feature: Ảnh chụp bài viết: chữ · rộng · vị trí · theme
features.ours: card tab → the parameters /api/image/card already takes.
features.reason: Slice 4. Changing a value means the card re-renders next run, same as theirs.

features.feature: Phụ đề: mẫu karaoke
features.ours: captions tab reads deploy/assets/caption-presets.json — one file, two readers (preview + render).
features.reason: Exists today; the tab adds the wall of samples.

features.feature: Khung hình: 3 bố cục · 531 ảnh nền
features.ours: frame tab: layout presets (card-top / card-centre / continuous) + shipped background set.
features.reason: Presets are content: ≥ 6 per tab or the tab is not done. Own uploads come from Assets.

features.feature: Nhãn dán: bộ sticker · bìa · mở đầu
features.ours: Sticker set from Assets, applied on cover/intro by an overlay step after the engine.
features.reason: Slice 5. ffmpeg overlay beside make-reel.py, never inside it.

features.feature: Chữ ký trôi (DVD)
features.ours: A moving overlay across the whole clip.
features.reason: Renderer work; second plan.

features.feature: Watermark chìm
features.ours: Static tiled watermark by the same overlay step.
features.reason: Slice 5.

features.feature: Ngôn ngữ + dịch
features.ours: VI only now.
features.reason: AILP already renders EN + VI; comes when the two apps share the kit.

features.feature: Lấy profile TikTok · kênh đăng tự động
features.ours: — · the publish step later, sanctioned APIs only.
features.reason: No TikTok tool here; auto-post is the publish step of a later slice.

features.feature: canvas Hook / Thân / Mở đầu · lớp · khoá · undo
features.ours: Frame presets are the layout system. A canvas with draggable text/image/shape layers starts only if presets fail.
features.reason: Slice 7, conditional: after two weeks of use, the owner names a layout presets cannot express. Layers would live in the kit and render through the overlay step.

features.feature: CẢNH #n · likes · Text TTS · Text gốc · Nghe thoại
features.ours: Run page scene list: post first, then each selected comment with its score, original text on hover, per-scene edit + Nghe thử.
features.reason: Slice 1 (fixture) → 3 (real). Nested replies indented one level.

features.feature: COMMENT KHÁC · n · Ẩn không chọn
features.ours: The comment pool under the scenes: every comment with score, checkbox to promote, hide unselected.
features.reason: Sources with comments: Reddit (score), own Threads (likes), gold rows (comment_1..3).

features.feature: Chỉnh tiếp & render lại
features.ours: Re-run this step; runs resume from the failed or edited step.
features.reason: Slice 1. A step writes its record on success and on failure.

features.feature: tìm · sắp xếp · lưới/danh sách · hôm nay
features.ours: Same, plus a tooltip with file name, size, status; download via /api/video/file.
features.reason: Slice 5.

features.feature: Có thể bạn cũng thích
features.ours: The Suggestions strip, same query as New.
features.reason: Slice 0.

features.feature: giữ 24 giờ
features.ours: We keep everything.
features.reason: It is our disk.

features.feature: ảnh nền · video nền · sticker · nhạc · 50 MB
features.ours: Assets page: own uploads (bg, sticker, music) with a quota bar; listed next to shipped presets in the kit tabs.
features.reason: Slice 5. Uploads only — no Pinterest / MyInstants fetching (licensing).
